channel.title: Business Studio KH
channel.description: The newest Business Studio KH for Macs that already have it.

item.title: Version 0.1.125
item.description: - Background removal now runs in a small hidden helper window of its own, which closes itself when it is not in use. The window you work in keeps the strictest security policy, and the app holds nothing in the background between removals. - Business Studio KH can update itself from now on: it checks a signed update file for this Mac, pauses its own work first, and installs without a prompt or a click. - NOTE — If macOS says the app is damaged when you open it, run this once in Terminal: xattr -cr "/Applications/Business Studio KH.app"
